Previously (#80 behaviour) bare integer right-padded column’s maximum width – included non-count cells like "75.2 (8.59)" (12 chars) – gained stray leading spaces count digits line , worst %. realign_count_pct() / format_count_pct() conversion unchanged (e.g. "0 (0.0%)" still becomes "0", "10 (100.0)" still "10 (100)") (#148).

title: rtfreporter (development version)
text: Reference pages made easier read (#150): list-valued parameters now break keys \describe{} list (sub-option headlined), examples fuller story-driven. First batch: rtf_document() (page / default_format keys + full worked example), rtf_section() (secinfo keys + self-contained example), rtf_header() / rtf_footer() (l / c / r cell rule + page-number tokens). functions follow. Continued sweep (#150): read_gt token list rtf_tables(), accepted row forms rtf_col_header(), cover fields / toc shapes / toc_page_numbering options assemble_rtf() now use \describe{} lists instead plain bullet prose.

title: rtfreporter 0.4.0
text: rtftable() gains blank_row_normalize argument controlling two render-time blank-row clean-ups, forwarded as_rtftables() / rtf_tables() (#136): "detect" renders data row whose every cell NA / "" (empty ASCII-whitespace ) single full-width blank row instead one empty cell per column; "collapse" reduces run two consecutive blank rows (separators /detected empty rows) one. Default c("detect", "collapse") (); pass "none" / NULL disable. act rendered table, paginated table apply per page (split). NBSP indentation whitespace-empty, indented sub-rows never mistaken blanks. Note: default , existing -empty data row now renders one merged blank cell rather N empty cells. as_rtftables() / as_rtftable() gain collapse_repeats argument blanks consecutive repeated values named column(s) – repeat suppression row-label / key columns (#131). first value run kept; rest become NA (rendered empty cell, row removed). Pass character / integer vector columns. several columns suppression hierarchical: first column collapses value, later column combination earlier listed columns (change higher column restarts lower column’s run). runs per page, split, pagination still sees original repeated values – group boundaries " (Cont.)" labels stay correct, group continued onto next page repeats label top. (group_by terms: value-based grouping happens first, column collapsed "filled"-style display.) as_rtftables() group-aware pagination (split = "group_safe" / "group_force" / "by_value") gains group_by argument selects group boundary detected, decoupled group_col (now selects column) (#128): "indent" – non-empty, non-whitespace-leading cell starts group (previous behaviour, now usable column, just column 1); "value" – maximal runs value form group; "filled" – non-empty cell starts group, NA / "" cells members (new); "auto" (default) – picks one column content, existing tables unaffected. group_col now accepts integer index defaults column 1, grouping column need first column. (gt/gtsummary body keeps gt’s column ids, e.g. "label"; rtables/flextable/huxtable columns renamed V1, V2, … – integer index portable.) as_rtftables() / as_rtftable() can now read huxtable objects (#120), joining gt, gtsummary, rtables/tern flextable. displayed text read huxtable’s number_format applied; header rows (header_rows()) become column header, colspan() becomes spanning header, per-column align() carried, caption() becomes page title. (huxtable data.frame subclass, detected plain-data.frame path.) huxtable footnote concept, none extracted; per-cell styling carried. New read_meta tokens huxtable: "col_header", "alignment", "spanning", "titles". Document-wide style defaults row height cell padding (#124). Set row_height_twips, cell_padding_left_twips cell_padding_right_twips whole report – via rtf_document(default_format = list(...)) / rtf_config(default_format = list(...)), globally rtfreporter.row_height_twips / rtfreporter.cell_padding_left_twips / rtfreporter.cell_padding_right_twips options – apply uniformly content table, page header/footer band, title/footnote blocks. defaults: per-module value (rtftable(), rtf_header(), rtf_footer(), rtf_table_style()) always overrides . Resolution highest-wins: per-module > document default_format > rtfreporter.* option > font-aware / resource baseline. Default output unchanged. part , rtftable() / rtf_tables() cell_padding_left_twips / cell_padding_right_twips now default NULL (“inherit”) instead 0L, unset padding can pick document default explicit 0 still renders flush. (also repairs dormant rtf_table_style() path whose cell padding never seeded table.) as_rtftables() / as_rtftable() can now read flextable objects (#119), joining gt, gtsummary rtables/tern. displayed cell text read via flextable’s exported introspection API (information_data_chunk() / information_data_paragraph()), set_header_labels() relabelling colformat_*() formatting honoured. Column (leaf) labels, spanning headers, per-column alignment, caption (title) footer lines (footnotes) carried; per-cell styling, explicit widths footnote() reference marks . New read_meta tokens flextable: "col_header", "alignment", "spanning", "titles", "footnotes". Titles footnotes reworked (#117): now render single-column table width content (table figure), blocks line content /instead spanning full page width. titles / footnotes accept length-1 list well one-per-page: single block applied every page (common title/footnote). Applies rtf_titles(), rtf_footnotes(), rtf_tables(), rtf_figures(). Per-row styling: block element may styled list(text=, align=, bold=, italic=, underline=, color=, border=) (addition plain character vector). Defaults unchanged (title rows centred + bold; footnote rows left, top-rule separator first row), footnote separator now overridable per row via border=. Package defaults now configurable options read function/page-key defaults. Every rtfreporter.* default (paper size, orientation, margins, font, font size) resolves : explicit argument > getOption("rtfreporter.*") > factory baseline. site can set defaults Rprofile.site – e.g. options(rtfreporter.font = "Arial") – every report inherits , rtfreporter.* keys remain single source truth seeded load. New helpers rtfreporter_options() (snapshot resolved configuration, useful audit trail) rtfreporter_reset_defaults() (restore factory baseline) (#111). header/footer band distance now explicit page setting, header_dist_in / footer_dist_in (matching rtfreporter.page.* options), instead computed silently. left unset still defaults half top/bottom margin, preserving previous output (#111). Page geometry gains paper_size preset key: page = list(paper_size = "A4") selects named size ("letter", "legal", "A4", "A3", "A5", case-insensitive) orients (paper_size = "A4" A4 landscape one line). Geometry resolution also rationalized: explicit width_in / height_in now win used given, orientation inferred ; orientation contradicts dimensions warns dimensions kept (supersedes #106 behaviour orientation re-oriented given dimensions). paper_size supplied alongside explicit dimensions ignored warning. Applies rtf_document(page=) rtf_config(page=) (#110). rtf_config() now merges page default_format per key instead replacing whole block, changing paper size (example rtf_config(page = list(width_in = 11.69, height_in = 8.27))) keeps document’s existing orientation margins. clarifies split two functions: rtf_document() constructs new document defaults, rtf_config() edits already-composed document (content sections preserved), changing keys pass. font_table / color_table still whole-object replacements (#108). Page orientation now authoritative: set, long/short page sides assigned match , rtf_document(page = list(orientation = "landscape", width_in = 8.27, height_in = 11.69)) (A4 sizes either order) reliably produces A4 landscape. orientation omitted inferred dimensions (width_in >= height_in means landscape), invalid orientation now rejected. Applies rtf_document(page=) rtf_config(page=) (#106).

Section-separated pages (\sect + \sectd\sbkpage) unaffected. visible as_rtftables(split = "group_safe") plain (page-number token) multi-page splits (#130, #138). automatic spanning-header group underline now drawn column grouping actually changes cell (next header row subdivides span). title: rtfreporter 0.3.4

CONTRIBUTING.md now describes concrete backlog/progress-tracking scheme multiple contributors: “rtfreporter roadmap” GitHub Projects board defined Status columns (Backlog/Ready/progress/review/Blocked/Done), Priority/Area/Agent custom fields, built-automation, one-time maintainer setup commands – alongside relates existing exec:* dispatch labels release milestones (#83).

Indent-based grouping clarified. auto-detected group semantics (default group_col = NULL) now explicitly documented indent-based: rows whose first column starts non-space character open new top-level group; rows leading whitespace (depth) stay current group. Multi-level layouts like therefore split / blank correctly box, using group1 group2 unit.
code: group1     sub-row 1     sub-row 2         sub-sub-row 3 group2     ...

title: rtfreporter 0.1.0
text: paginate() — unified table-object per-page data.frame list (#2). Single S3 entry point converts [gt::gt()] table, plain data.frame, list either list data.frames sized one RTF page , ready passed rtf_tables(). Splitting strategies: split = "none" (default) — pass single page. split = "rows" — manual force-split row indices split_rows. split = "group_safe" — pack whole groups onto page; spill overflow. single group larger max_rows force-split (Cont.) continuation rows. split = "group_force" — cut every max_rows; cut lands inside group, next page begins <label> (Cont.) header row whose summary value cells blanked . Groups either auto-detected leading-whitespace indentation first column (default) specified explicitly via group_col =. Blank-row positions can supplied integer vector, keyword "between_groups" (auto-inserts blank detected groups), list(...) combining . Positions attached rtf_blank_rows attribute returned data.frame consumed automatically rtftable(read_attributes = TRUE). Extending new table-object type one S3 method: Added Suggests:: gt (>= 0.9.0).
code: paginate.your_class <- function(x, ...) {   df <- ...extract a data.frame from x...   paginate.data.frame(df, ...) }

title: rtfreporter 0.1.0
text: Unified column-header API. Multi-row column headers can now written single uniform form using pos = cell specs, regardless whether top-row spanning row plain label row. Previously first row use either col_header (spanning) spanning_header (separate argument); now spanning every level (including first) expressed way. col_cell(pos, label, ...) — one cell. pos = 1 single column; pos = c(2, 5) spans data columns 2–5. Positions always refer underlying data columns. rtf_col_header(row1, row2, ...) — collect rows top--bottom. add_col_header_row(hdr, row, .position = c("bottom", "top")) — incremental builder. Example: bare list col_cell()s auto-wrapped single header row, col_header = list(col_cell(1, "Item"), col_cell(c(2, 3), "M (SD)")) works. previously-accepted forms (c("", "B", "C"), mixed lists list(, , label, ...) specs, standalone spanning_header = argument) continue work unchanged.
code: rtftable(df, col_header = rtf_col_header(   list(col_cell(1, ""), col_cell(c(2, 5), "Treatment")),   list(col_cell(1, ""),        col_cell(c(2, 3), "Drug A"),        col_cell(c(4, 5), "Drug B")),   c("Item", "N", "Mean", "N", "Mean") ))

what: Default changes (potentially visible to existing reports)
title: rtfreporter 0.1.0
text: Cell padding default lowered 0 twips (72 twips ≈ 0.05 inch sides). Header, footer content-table cells now sit flush cell border default, matching typical clinical TFL look. Callers want old behaviour can opt : rtftable(..., cell_padding_left_twips = 72L, cell_padding_right_twips = 72L). Reflected inst/resources/rtfreporter_defaults.R. top / bottom: 0.75 inch → 0.9 inch left / right: 0.5 inch → 0.6 inch Callers passing explicit page metrics unaffected.

title: rtfreporter 0.1.0
text: Added pkgdown site published GitHub Pages https://ichirio.github.io/rtfreporter/. Migrated test suite bare tests/test-*.R scripts testthat (edition 3) tests/testthat/. Added GitHub Actions workflows R CMD check (Ubuntu, macOS, Windows × R-release / devel / oldrel-1), pkgdown deployment, test coverage reporting via covr + Codecov. DESCRIPTION modernised: full author/maintainer information, URL, BugReports, expanded Description, Depends: R (>= 4.1), optional Suggests: testthat covr. LICENSE converted CRAN’s YEAR / COPYRIGHT HOLDER template full MIT text moved LICENSE.md. README.md rewritten installation instructions, runnable 30-second example, badges. Community files added: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, GitHub issue pull-request templates.

title: rtfreporter 0.1.0
text: Removed R6 usage. rtftable_r6, rtfplot_r6, rtfreport_r6, R6 versions rtf_border rtf_table_style now plain S3 records. class names lose _r6 suffix (inherits(x, "rtftable") etc.). Imports: R6 dropped DESCRIPTION. rtf_border_with(b, top = ..., bottom = ..., ...) non-mutating border derivation. rtf_table_style_with(style, ...) non-mutating style derivation. rtf_table_style(...) now called function (rtf_table_style$new(...)). “share style instance, mutate , see every existing table reflect change” pattern longer applies. rtftable() call snapshots style fields needs construction time. Build new style rtf_table_style_with() pass new tables.

title: rtfreporter 0.1.0
text: Public S3 print methods now exported rtf_border, rtf_border_side, rtf_table_border, rtf_table_style.

title: rtfreporter 0.1.0
text: Data section now default borders. TFL preset rtf_border_tfl() longer paints horizontal rule last data row; default borders belong column-header block . Callers want bottom rule last data row can still set explicitly: rtf_table_border(last_row = rtf_border(bottom = rtf_border_side())). Earlier versions: see CHANGELOG.md detailed pre-v0.0.18 history.
